eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 6:04 PM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 6:04 PM JUL 28, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Monday, July 27, 2026, 6:00 PM: EVACUATION WARNINGS have been lifted for zones 097-A, 097-B, 099, 101, 105, 107, 109, 111, 113, 115, 141, and 143-A.  These areas have returned to NORMAL STATUS. This effects the communities of Big Pine and Fort Independence.
